import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/world.db')
cursor = conn.cursor()

# List all tables

tables = [r[0] for r in cursor.fetchall()]
print("=== TABLES ===")
print(tables)

# Show schema for each table
print("\\n=== SCHEMAS ===")
for t in tables:
    cursor.execute(f"PRAGMA table_info({t});")
    cols = cursor.fetchall()
    col_names = [c[1] for c in cols]
    print(f"{t}: {col_names}")

# Search for any column containing 'zip', 'postal', 'address', 'city', 'state' in name
print("\\n=== ZIP/ADDRESS COLUMNS ===")
for t in tables:

    for c in cols:
        col_name = c[1].lower()
        if any(kw in col_name for kw in ['zip', 'postal', 'address', 'city', 'state', 'location']):

            cursor.execute(f"SELECT DISTINCT [{c[1]}] FROM {t} LIMIT 10;")
            vals = [r[0] for r in cursor.fetchall()]
            print(f"  {t}.{c[1]}: {vals}")

conn.close()
"""
await write_file("./check_db.py", db_script)

# Extract all zip codes from the addr_output variable
zip_matches = re.findall(r'"zip":\s*"(\d{5}(?:-\d{4})?)"', addr_output)

user_zip_pairs = re.findall(r'User:\s+(.+?)\s+\(ID:\s+(.+?)\)\s.*?"zip":\s*"(\d{5})"', addr_output, re.DOTALL)

# Extract order-zip associations
order_zip_pairs = re.findall(r'Order:\s+(.+?),\s+Customer:\s+(.+?)\s.*?"zip":\s*"(\d{5})"', addr_output, re.DOTALL)

print(f"\n=== ORDER-ZIP ASSOCIATIONS (first 10) ===")
for oid, cid, z in order_zip_pairs[:10]:
    print(f"  Order {oid}, Customer {cid}: {z}")
